source_note: Rules were statically extracted from LAP Hub per-level kind:tech requires entries and mapped to canonical node IDs by branch, rendered name, max level, and exact complete cost/time/scroll/might signatures. No rules were inferred from layout parents, IDs, names, or ordering. Same-node level sequencing is already enforced by ProgressionGraph and is omitted because node-level self-edges would be cycles. LAP Hub's aggregate Squad 1/Squad 2 25% and Elite Troop 40%/80% branch locks cannot be represented by this node-to-node tuple schema; the observed Elite Troop gates are retained as metadata in cross_tree_gates and are not emitted as synthetic records. source_generated_at is the UTC extraction time because the content-hashed assets expose no generation timestamp.

intra_tree_linear_prerequisites.enforcement: ProgressionGraph resolves each node's levels contiguously from current_level + 1 through target_level; same-node edges would be node-DAG self-loops.
